title: feat(ui): load machine and post files from the user's disk in the browser
body:
## What changed

The browser build now loads the user's own machine (`.mch`) and post (`.cps`) files. The bytes come from the browser, not from a path.

- **Load machine (.mch)** and **Load post (.cps)** are live in the browser. They open the browser file picker. A picked machine is mounted. A picked post is selected.
- The Machine page has a new button **Load folder (.mch, .cps)** in the browser build only. It opens `<input webkitdirectory multiple>`. It adds each `.mch` and `.cps` file of the folder to the session lists. It does not need the File System Access API.
- A drop with a `.mch` or `.cps` file goes to a new module `setup_file_drop`. One file is mounted or selected. Several files only join the lists. One status line counts the files that landed and names each refused file with its reason.
- On the desktop, one dropped `.mch` or `.cps` on disk goes to `LoadMachineFile` or `SelectPostFile` by its full path.
- The domain module `camcraft_post::session_files`, re-exported by app, keeps each file by its bare name for the session, on the thread that loaded it. The caller passes app machine validation and holder-aware parsing as a callback. A file enters it only when it passes the checks of a file from disk: a machine must validate and parse, a post must compile and run.
- The readers of machine and post files consult the session store first, then the disk. So `LoadMachineFile`, `SelectPostFile` and the MCP tools run unchanged. Each mount and post choice stays one undo step.
- Session machines show in the machine catalogue (`library::enumerate`). Session posts show in the post combo list.
- A saved project that names a session file which is not loaded again is refused by that name (#2319). There is no fallback.

## Cause

The browser build had no disk and no picker for these files. `browser_files::refusal` greyed Load machine and Load post with `NEEDS_PICKER`. The file drop took model files only. The readers of `PostRef::File` and the machine file read only from disk.

## Tests

Pins in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/browser_setup_files.rs`:

- `a_dropped_mch_mounts_by_its_name_and_one_undo_takes_it_away`
- `a_dropped_cps_is_selected_and_posts_from_its_bytes`
- `several_dropped_files_land_and_each_bad_one_is_refused_by_name`
- `a_malformed_pick_is_refused_by_name_and_changes_nothing`
- `a_picked_folder_fills_both_lists_and_a_picked_file_mounts_or_selects`
- `the_machine_and_post_load_buttons_are_live_in_the_browser` (AccessKit label, role `Button`, enabled state for "Load machine (.mch)", "Load folder (.mch, .cps)" and "Load post (.cps)"; no folder button on the desktop)

Other tests:

- `session_files::tests::a_bad_file_is_refused_by_name_and_never_kept` (post unit test). `an_unloaded_session_post_is_refused_by_name_at_post_time` pins a project that names a file that is not loaded.
- `setup_file_drop::tests::one_file_is_for_its_own_kind_in_any_case`.
- Updated for the new law: `browser_files::tests::every_picker_and_folder_command_is_refused_by_name_in_the_browser`, `a_picker_the_browser_lacks_is_refused_by_name_not_ignored`, `a_file_button_is_greyed_with_its_reason_in_the_browser`.

Red before the fix (reduced pins on unchanged `upstream/main`):

- the drop pins failed with `drop refused: drop-2950-vmc.mch is not a model file (read: .stl, .obj, .step, .stp, .sc, .solidcraft)`;
- the button pin failed with `LoadMachineDialog runs the browser's picker` / `left: Some("Not available in the browser yet: ...")`.

Mutation checks (old code put back, pins run, code restored):

- `crates/ui/src/browser_files.rs` from upstream: `the_machine_and_post_load_buttons_are_live_in_the_browser` red.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` from upstream (drop route not called): the three drop pins red.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` from upstream (no session read at post time): `a_dropped_cps_is_selected_and_posts_from_its_bytes` red.
- `session_files::add_post` without its compile check: `several_dropped_files_land_and_each_bad_one_is_refused_by_name` red.
- All pins green again after each restore.

Gate:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` ran all 428 steps on the previous head. 427 passed. `ui suites: lib` failed in three machines-pane tests. The cause was a process-global store: the session machines of the new tests leaked into the machine list of tests on other threads.
- The fix makes the store thread-local. The browser runs on one thread.
- On the final head, `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only "app suites: lib" --only "ui suites: lib"` is green (ui lib 1385 passed, 0 failed). Only `crates/app/src/session_files.rs` changed between the two heads, plus one test comment and the decision file. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

## Goldens moved

None.

## Not exercised

- The wasm32 build. The `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target is not installed on this machine, so the wasm-only code was not compiled. That code is: the folder input and batch read in `file_pick.rs`, the async drop read in `setup_file_drop.rs`, and the dialog openers in `state_picked.rs`. A reviewer with the target must run `cargo check -p camcraft-ui --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`.
- A real browser. The tests use `State::browser_build` and in-memory drops as the stand-in.
- Persistence in IndexedDB. Not built. The decision file lists the options for the maintainer.

## Overlaps

- #3057 changes `file_drop::take_drop`. This PR does not change that function. It adds `setup_file_drop::take`, which `shell.rs` calls before `take_drop`. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- Several open PRs touch `crates/app/src/posting.rs` and `crates/ui/src/state.rs` in other functions. This PR changes only `script_of`, `resolve_cps` (one line each), the `LoadMachineDialog` / `SelectPostDialog` arms and one new `CommandKind` variant.

## MCP

No new MCP tool. The browser routes go through the existing `LoadMachineFile` and `SelectPostFile` commands, and the MCP machine and post tools read the session store through the same readers. `LoadSetupFolderDialog` is a browser-only picker. It changes no document state.

Decision file: `docs/decisions/2950-browser-machine-post-files.md`.

Effort: high

Changelog: The browser build loads your own machine (.mch) and post (.cps) files from a picker, a folder picker or a drop; a bad file is refused by name.

Fixes #2950

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)


## Review fixes

- A different post under an existing name is refused. Identical text is accepted. `same_name_folder_and_picker_leave_the_selected_post_and_history_stable` pins the selected post and history.
- One browser batch has a 32 MiB raw-byte limit. Both file lists share a 32 MiB retained-name-and-text limit. Refusals name the file. `individually_allowed_files_cannot_exceed_the_batch_budget` and `retained_text_budget_covers_both_lists_and_refuses_by_name` pin the limits.
- A successful machine import invalidates the machine catalogue. `a_folder_machine_import_invalidates_the_populated_catalogue` starts with a populated catalogue and pins the refreshed list.
- Pure storage and readers belong to `camcraft-post`. App supplies its existing machine checks through a callback. `pure_session_readers_are_available_without_the_app` pins the domain API.

## Machine and Post page images

These images show the shipped pages through the native render harness with the browser flag enabled. They are not browser captures.
Before uses the actual PR parent page and browser refusal code. After uses the review fix source.
The capture checks that the old load buttons are disabled, the new load buttons are enabled, and the folder button appears.
The files exist only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

| Page | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Machine | ![Machine before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/3160/machine-before.png) | ![Machine after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/3160/machine-after.png) |
| Post | ![Post before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/3160/post-before.png) | ![Post after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/3160/post-after.png) |

## Heavy lanes

Validated unchanged head `5e7c2b0d006c543316df6c062608aa2969c01722` on 2026-11-22.
The run used freshly fetched `upstream/main` at `148a5c832aa811bab9cae5c7f69e0ad945ee92d4`.
The shared base reference advanced to `ef157211438104997fc9e51f7e3affc4db303545` during execution. This result records the starting base.

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: GREEN, exit 0; 199 steps, 0 failed steps; 45.7 minutes.
- `cargo xtask gate batch --only "app suites: example_catalog"`: GREEN, exit 0; 1 step; 33 tests passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored.
- The heavy `example_catalog` step ran both ignored catalog tests. Both passed.
- No goldens changed. No source files changed. No new commit or push was needed.

The heavy gate accepted four registered expected failures. These are not new failures:

- #2849: `an_axis_aligned_lead_start_posts_the_users_arc_entry_as_g18_or_g19`.
- #2849: `the_horizontal_arc_entry_on_the_users_pocket_verifies_silent`.
- #2849: `fig8_outside_containment_with_em0800_and_clearing_kinds_works`.
- #1950: `the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level`.

This round runs the checks owed by the clean review of this head. It adds no code fix or new mutation check.
The earlier review records the quick gate, clippy, and mutation results. This round does not repeat those checks.
